Chaiwala Labs Privacy Notice

1. We collect your name, email address and mobile number to create and secure your account, your delivery address to deliver your orders, and your payment status to confirm payment. We use each item only for the purpose listed next to it.

2. We ask for your consent separately for each purpose, using unticked checkboxes that you choose to tick. Using the app does not by itself mean you consent.

3. You can withdraw your consent at any time from Settings > Privacy in the app, as easily as you gave it. Once you withdraw consent, we and our service providers will stop processing your personal data within a reasonable time, unless the law requires otherwise.

4. We keep your personal data accurate, complete and up to date, and you can change it from your account.

5. We protect your data with encryption in transit and at rest, role-based access controls, and access logs that we monitor.

6. If a personal data breach affects you, we will inform you without delay and will also inform the Data Protection Board as the law requires.

7. We erase your personal data when you withdraw consent or when it is no longer needed for the purpose it was collected for, unless a law requires us to keep it. Records of processing are kept for one year, as the DPDP Rules require, and then erased.

8. Questions about how we process your personal data can be sent to our Data Protection Officer, Anita Rao, at dpo@chaiwala.in or +91 80 4000 1234.

9. To raise a grievance, write to grievance@chaiwala.in. We will respond within 30 days, and in any case within ninety days of receiving it. If you are not satisfied with our response, you may complain to the Data Protection Board of India.

10. You can ask us for a summary of the personal data we process about you and the businesses we have shared it with. You may also ask us to correct, complete, update or erase your personal data.

11. You may nominate another person to exercise your rights in the event of your death or incapacity.

12. Our services are for people aged 18 or over. If you are under 18, we process your personal data only with the verifiable consent of your parent or lawful guardian. We do not track or behaviourally monitor users under 18, and we do not show them targeted advertising.

13. Your data is stored in India and may be processed by our cloud provider on servers located in Singapore. We do not transfer personal data to any country restricted by the Government of India.

14. This notice is available in English and in any language listed in the Eighth Schedule to the Constitution.
